personality_one_liner: A modern, highly readable, and trustworthy fintech experience prioritizing clarity and cross-linguistic legibility over decorative noise.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly dont have extra spaces where its not required, handle padding and margin corectly and subtle for buttons and components

do's: Bottom tab bar (when content scrolls behind it)
Featured / hero cards frosted glass overlay sitting on a brand-tinted backdrop

screens.name: Onboarding & Language Picker
screens.purpose: Introduce the app and allow the user to select their preferred language using native scripts.
screens.layout: Full-bleed background or large hero image. A structured bottom sheet or list for language selection displaying native names (हिंदी, தமிழ், etc.) without flags. Sticky primary CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Login & Register
screens.layout: Clean single-column form layout. Labels above inputs. Sticky 'Continue' or 'Login' button at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Dashboard (Home)
screens.purpose: All-in-one personal finance overview showing total balance, income vs expense summary, and spending charts.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for cards and charts
states.empty: Illustration with prompt to add first account or transaction
states.error: Readable error message with a 'Tap to retry' button

screens.layout: Hero card at the top displaying Total Balance (using gradient or glass overlay). Segmented control below to toggle views (e.g., This Month / Last Month). A horizontal scroll or grid for Quick Actions. A dedicated card for the spending category chart, followed by a preview of recent transactions.

screens.name: Transactions
screens.purpose: Detailed chronological list of transactions with add/edit functionality.

states.empty: Empty wallet illustration, 'No transactions yet', and a primary CTA to add one.

screens.layout: Sticky header with search/filter icons. List rows with generous minimum tap heights (56pt). Each row displays an avatar (merchant initials or logo), transaction name, date, amount (color-coded polarity: green for deposit, default for withdrawal), and a status badge if needed. A FAB (Floating Action Button) anchored at bottom-right for 'Add Transaction'.

screens.name: Accounts & Budgets
screens.purpose: List of linked accounts and progress trackers for savings goals.

states.empty: Illustration suggesting user to set up a budget or link an account

screens.layout: Multi-column grid (2-col) for smaller account cards or full-width stacked cards. Budgets use progress bars inside cards to indicate savings goal completion.

screens.name: AI Money Assistant
screens.purpose: Chat interface for financial advice and queries.

states.empty: Friendly AI robot illustration with suggested query chips (e.g., 'Analyze my spending').
states.error: Message failed to send, tap to retry

screens.layout: Standard chat layout. Message bubbles differentiating user (brand color) vs AI (surfaceSecondary). Sticky input field at the bottom. Use abstract background for the chat area if needed.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow '1 iOS-Native Clean' principles: generous padding, clear hierarchical grouping, and focus on readable typography over decorative chrome. Avoid dense dashboard clutter.
BANNED COLORS: All blues (including navy, indigo, violet) are strictly prohibited. The brand palette uses Botanical / Forest Green tones to establish trust.

Typography & Localization: Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for Latin scripts. For Indic languages (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Marathi), ensure proper system font fallbacks since custom geometric sans fonts may lack full Devanagari/Tamil glyphs. Test text rendering heavily.
Language Picker UI: Do not use country flags for languages. Use a globe icon and write language names in their native scripts (e.g., हिंदी, தமிழ், English).

Transaction Lists: Treat transaction metadata as first-class UI. Include merchant avatars (initials or fetched logos), color-coded amounts (+ in green, - in default text color), dates, and badges. Use a sticky FAB for adding transactions.

Hero/Featured Sections: Utilize the fetched 'hero_background' gradient with an overlay scrim (gradient-to-dark) if text is layered on top to guarantee WCAG contrast ratios. Use glassmorphism over the brand background for the primary balance card.
Ensure sticky CTA patterns: For long scrolling forms or setups (e.g., Onboarding, Add Transaction), pin the primary CTA to the bottom above the safe area, independent of the scrolling content.
AI Chat: Differentiate user and AI messages with surface colors (e.g., user gets brand-tinted bubble, AI gets surfaceSecondary). Include the AI avatar in the empty state.
